scopeNotes: Validation uses a disposable independent Unity project; the game's Client/UnityProject was not modified.
This validates default FBX import, mesh bounds, transforms, topology counts and material slots only.
No Unity collider is expected in the source model. This is an environment art prototype, not a playable scene.
Shader/color data reflects default Unity FBX import and does not certify URP appearance or gameplay integration.
The full Exports/Textures sidecar folder was supplied alongside TrainingCourtyard.fbx for this import; no previous stone model or textures remained in Assets.

Material slots and base colors were read back. The Meshy decoration had base-color, normal, and emission textures assigned by Standard material import. URP material conversion, roughness/metallic mapping, lightmap UV2, colliders, and gameplay behavior are outside this validation.

sourceGeometryComparison.triangleCountNote: These are separate measured counts. Any difference is recorded rather than treated as evidence of a specific importer optimization.
